definition.population: same controller/scenario fixed repeats 1,2,3 on both modes; no replacement or best-subset selection
definition.statistic: arithmetic mean of per-trial RMSE and duration, sample standard deviation ddof=1, worst=max; not pooled RMSE or mean of ratios
definition.eligibility: all six trials completed and passed with valid source-time scores and nonnegative finite selected RMSE/duration
definition.descriptive_scope: fixed-repeat observed values, including failed trials; missing values remain null; means of incomplete/ineligible groups are descriptive only
